scope: GM-R1 production identity/permissions/startup, public playback, both complete-root replacements, both hide/show paths, sole writer and preference reload. GM-R2/R3/R4 remain open.

artifact.automaticEvidenceReused: The preflight's 144 targeted tests, Userscript typecheck and production build apply to the same unchanged recorded inputs. No new source edit or root-wide gate run is claimed.

environment.runtime: installed production Userscript with real Tampermonkey APIs
environment.managerEvidence: Actual manager UI and chrome.runtime.getManifest; stored editor code hash matches candidate.
environment.hostType: Plain static HTML without product entry, scripts or GM substitutes.

workflow.resolution: User explicitly authorized restarting only the dedicated chrome-devtools-mcp/chrome-profile browser. PID 36528 was revalidated and stopped; daily browser profiles were untouched.
workflow.installation: Standard Tampermonkey reinstall UI from a loopback server serving the frozen exact candidate; manager editor was then independently hashed. Existing production library state survived.

hostServer.servesOnly: Frozen /any-music.user.js and plain / or /gm-r1.html; other paths return 404.

inspectionMethods: Browser-tool pointer clicks, text entry, select-by-visible-label and Escape for product interactions.
Read-only DOM/audio/reference/event probes and temporary manager webRequest observer for assertions.
DOM click used only for manager enable/disable toggles; no DOM click substituted for the tested product actions.
A temporary hidden same-origin iframe checks noframes and is removed immediately.

cases.name: Installed production identity, permissions, lazy startup and sole writer
observations: Stored installed code is 5,021,592 bytes with the exact candidate SHA-256; 16 grants and 14 connect domains match the packaged configuration.
Production Any Music is enabled and both development scripts are disabled.
Manager loader registrations run at document_start. These are generic manager loaders; actual script metadata and frame test establish the individual script's noframes boundary.
Before first expansion: one launcher host, zero audio nodes, no host script elements, no page-global GM APIs and no preview storage keys. First expansion mounts one product root and one idle audio.
Existing three production request rows load without an implicit import/play request. After the explicit new import there are four rows.
While the original workbench is hidden and playing, another tab's expansion is refused visibly with AM-1900 and retry guidance; the original audio continues.
The top document has one launcher host and a loaded same-origin iframe has zero; the fixture iframe is removed.

cases.name: Public import and native playback
observations: One explicit import produces one loaded track and one page via one manager-initiated /x/web-interface/view request.
One explicit track playback produces one manager-initiated /x/player/playurl request and browser-native HTTPS CDN streaming.
The audio has readyState 4, duration 2055.591701 seconds and advancing currentTime; it is explicitly paused at 456.481108 seconds.

cases.name: Both theme directions and hide/show continuity
observations: Default -> Studio -> Default retains the sole identical audio element and currentSrc with advancing time: baseline 42.010542, Studio 74.752971 and committed Default 158.548763 seconds.
Default hide/show retains the same audio/source: hidden 185.237873, restored after second-writer refusal 205.627833 seconds.
The later Studio hide/show also retains the same audio/source: hidden 409.428239, restored 418.535924 seconds.
Selected track and one loaded page remain across both root replacements. Returning to the list overview later is an explicit navigation and is not treated as a theme-induced selection loss.
Unsubmitted search draft GM-R1 draft 2026-10-26 and the independent import URL survive both roots; the draft also returns after Studio hide/show.

The observer records no additional view or playurl request across these replacements/hide/show operations. Native media does make two GETs during sustained streaming; no zero-media-request assertion is made.
Audio event observation begins at 42.010542 seconds and contains no loadstart, emptied, play, ended, error or abort event. Its only pause event is the explicit final player pause.
Every sampled state has one active complete root and one audio node. No product --am-* style element appears in the host document.
Escape from the classic search dialog returns deep focus to its Discover button; this is a bounded keyboard smoke case, not full R4 acceptance.

cases.name: Reload restores stable preferences without implicit playback
observations: After choosing Studio again and explicitly pausing, reload returns to the lightweight launcher with zero audio nodes.
Expanding restores Studio, the unsubmitted search draft and the same four canonical request row IDs.
The new sole audio is paused at zero with readyState 0, no currentSrc, no src attribute and no srcObject; Play is disabled until an explicit new track choice.
The reload adds only the expected account nav refresh. Import/playurl/native media counts do not increase, and no warning/error console messages are observed after reload.
cases.limit: Observed empty media reinitialization and no replay; this pass does not dump every persisted product/cache value or claim a full storage-schema audit.

requests.method: Temporary read-only chrome.webRequest.onBeforeRequest observer in the manager service worker; records sanitized ID/time/host/path/method/type/initiator provenance only.

findings.accountSession: The product reported 状态不可用 for account status while public import/playback succeeded. Authenticated/private/source-host behavior belongs to GM-R3 and is not accepted here.
tooling: Browser file upload rejected the workspace path; exact candidate was installed through the bounded loopback server instead.

One immediate settings-picker click timed out; a fresh DOM/snapshot check and subsequent pointer click succeeded. Select controls use visible labels. No fallback DOM-driven product action was counted as native input acceptance.
No screenshot was retained; full visual/layout/input acceptance remains GM-R4.

handoff.currentBatch: GM-R1 complete for this candidate and exercised public-source environment
handoff.nextCase: Use the same unchanged production candidate for active/queued downloads, both theme directions, explicit cancellation/retry, final ZIP/save receipt and cold-start duplicate-save checks.
handoff.currentBrowserState: Dedicated acceptance Chrome retains production Any Music enabled, development scripts disabled and Studio expanded after reload. The new player is idle; no audio is left playing. The second-writer tab was closed and temporary frame/network observer removed.
handoff.changesRequiringRegression: Changed production inputs, metadata or rebuilt artifact require new hash evidence and appropriate related R1 regression; do not apply this pass to a later changed artifact.

evidenceConsistency.checks: Four passing cases, 14 audio-reference samples, committed theme IDs, one explicit pause, canonical row restoration, API/media counts, idle reload, observer cleanup and bilingual evidence links.
